videos.title: The Uneven Rings Left by a Moving Sound #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: Uneven wavefronts and a moving source appear immediately; the opening demonstrates the promised phenomenon.
editorial.mechanism: Fixed emission centers, explicit inspection freeze, labeled ahead/behind gap construction, and fixed listener markers connect propagation to arrival rate. The process resumes at the same phase.
editorial.readability: Wavefronts and captions remain separate; the gap bars now carry direct labels. Listener markers are visible but small.
editorial.pacing: The measured 1.3-second paragraph gaps are shorter than the prior batch. A long still interval is purposeful while travel distances are compared.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. Full decode and independent ASR differences reviewed. No subjective listening or claim of pleasing prosody.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: Listeners are only small circles, and no audible pitch comparison accompanies the sound explanation. The travel bars still require a spatial connection to the wavefield. The source model is subsonic sound in still air, not a light Doppler derivation.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: Why Distance Spreads a Little Light So Thin #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: The same light patch grows in the first seconds, giving a visible example before inverse-square terminology.
editorial.mechanism: The enlarged original patch divides into four then nine areas; the separate inset was removed. One cell is highlighted where its share is explained.
editorial.readability: The enlarged teal patch and direct subdivisions are legible at phone scale. Labels fade during changing geometry.
editorial.pacing: One persistent ray bundle supports the explanation without a diagram-to-inset jump. Later idealization sentences hold a stable result.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. Full decode and independent ASR differences reviewed. No subjective listening or claim of pleasing prosody.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The lamp remains a dot and the page a geometric patch, so the scene is still diagram-first. Fill color encodes the bundle rather than measured irradiance; a physical light-on-page comparison could make the opening more tangible. ASR heard 'and' for 'in' in one sentence, without changing the mathematical content.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Garden Hidden Inside the Same Fence #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A rectangle changes area at fixed perimeter before numbers appear, making the constraint visible through motion.
editorial.mechanism: Five, eight and nine cells lead to an attached strip dissection; rotating the matching piece leaves an exact square of lost area.
editorial.readability: The cells, labels and dissection are distinct. Example labels fade as the shape changes, then return with the new value.
editorial.pacing: The 70-second explanation has one question and one proof. The half-unit case gives a small extension after the unit example.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. Full decode and independent ASR differences reviewed. No subjective listening or claim of pleasing prosody.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The garden is still an abstract rectangle without a recognizable fence or ground. A newcomer must keep track of removed versus gained strips, and the half-unit case is displayed without replaying its matching move. The claim applies only to rectangles.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: The Water That Quietly Holds a Piece of Wood #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: A partially submerged block gives a recognizable state of balance, though its wood material is conveyed by narration rather than appearance.
editorial.mechanism: The block and its replacement water occupy the same boundary. Top/bottom pressure and equal parcel-weight support precede the sixty/eighty percent comparison.
editorial.readability: The water panel separates this composition from the geometry films. Percentages disappear during the depth change; the new value appears once settled.
editorial.pacing: The deliberate stills support pressure and counterfactual comparisons. Lowering and settling are illustrative, not numerical free-motion simulation.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. Full decode and independent ASR differences reviewed. No subjective listening or claim of pleasing prosody.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The wood is a coral rectangle, and the absent-water argument still asks the viewer to imagine a counterfactual. More recognizable material and an explicit physical displacement example could improve the everyday connection. No subjective listening or audience outcome is established.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.

videos.title: A Spiral That Grows Without Forgetting Its Shape #math #Shorts

editorial.opening: The spiral now reaches a recognizable form within the opening seconds; the earlier tiny, slow opening was revised.
editorial.mechanism: Larger radial examples show quarter-turn multiplication. The tangent/radial marker keeps its angle while moving, then a scaled and rotated copy aligns with the curve.
editorial.readability: The constant-angle label uses dark ink after the low-contrast accent version was revised. Overlapping red and teal curves communicate alignment.
editorial.pacing: The drawing and inspection marker have separate process phases; stable states support growth-factor and self-similarity comparisons.
editorial.sound: Dry local narration. Full decode and independent ASR differences reviewed. No subjective listening or claim of pleasing prosody.
editorial.remaining_weaknesses: The final curve is restrained but the explanation remains abstract. A closer view of the angle could help a novice distinguish tangent from outward radius. Natural resemblance is qualified and the chosen factor is explicitly not golden. Focused ASR did not reproduce the full-file duplicated word 'curve'.
editorial.audience_evidence: Not measured. No retention, recognition, learning or subscription results yet.
